items.q: Is accounting mandatory for every business in the UAE?
items.a: Yes. Under UAE Commercial Companies Law and FTA regulations, all registered businesses must maintain accurate accounting records for at least 5 years.

items.q: What accounting standard applies in the UAE?
items.a: IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards) is the primary standard. For multinationals, GAAP + IFRS dual reporting is often required.

items.q: How often do I have to file VAT returns in the UAE?
items.a: VAT returns are filed quarterly (or monthly for larger businesses) with the Federal Tax Authority (FTA).

items.q: What penalties exist for poor accounting in Dubai?
items.a: Fines range from AED 1,000 to AED 50,000+ depending on severity, with possible license suspension for repeated non-compliance.

items.q: Can you assist with VAT and Corporate Tax accounting?
items.a: Yes. We handle VAT registration, quarterly filing, corporate tax returns, and full FTA compliance.

items.q: What does your bookkeeping service include?
items.a: Daily recording of transactions, bank reconciliation, VAT reconciliation, monthly P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statements.

items.q: Do you provide audit preparation support?
items.a: Yes. We compile all required documents in advance, review ledgers, fix gaps, and represent you during FTA audits.

items.q: What accounting software do you work with?
items.a: We work with QuickBooks, Xero, Zoho Books, Tally, and custom ERP systems based on your business needs.
